name: Apartments Olga
description: Two studios and a one-bedroom apartment in a garden house on a quiet street in Bled, each with its own kitchen, a garden-view terrace, free Wi-Fi and free private parking.

narrative.heroText: Two studios and a one-bedroom apartment, each with a private entrance, its own kitchen and a terrace onto the garden. Free parking at the house; Lake Bled is 1.3 km away.
narrative.introTitle: Your own place, not a hotel room.
narrative.introText: The rooms are bright and full of colour: painted walls, patterned tiles, framed prints. Every apartment has its own kitchen or kitchenette with a dishwasher and microwave, so breakfast can be slow and dinner can be outside.

highlights.title: Your own door
highlights.text: Each apartment has a private entrance.

highlights.title: Free parking
highlights.text: Private parking at the house, no reservation needed.

highlights.title: Your own kitchen
highlights.text: Dishwasher, microwave and kettle in every apartment.

narrative.spacesText: Two studios for two, and a one-bedroom apartment for up to three. All on the ground floor, all with a terrace onto the garden.
narrative.settingTitle: A quiet street, a short walk from the lake.
narrative.settingText: Finžgarjeva cesta is a quiet residential street in Bled. Restaurants are about a kilometre away, and Lake Bled is 1.3 km from the gate.

practical.label: Check-in and check-out
practical.value: Check-in 14:00–22:00, check-out 07:00–10:00. Let the hosts know your arrival time in advance.

practical.label: Parking
practical.value: Free private parking at the house. No reservation needed.

practical.label: Children and beds
practical.value: Children of any age are welcome. There are no extra beds; whether a cot fits depends on the apartment, so ask first.

practical.label: Wi-Fi
practical.value: Free in all areas. If you need a steady connection for work, ask the hosts before you book.

practical.label: Pets and smoking
practical.value: Pets are not allowed. Smoking is not allowed.

practical.label: Languages
practical.value: The hosts speak Slovenian, English and German.

notes: Score, categories, house rules, coordinates, distances and booking status from the 2026-10-13 capture.

Three English review texts are quoted verbatim (positive part only), without guest names or countries; republication permission is not recorded.

testimonials.quote: A very comfortable stay. Location is lovely in a quiet suburban street. Close walk to the supermarket, bus stops and not too far to the Lake Bled either. The kitchen had a very homey vibe, and the bedroom was great. I really enjoyed my stay here :)
I loved the location and that it was very cool despite it being hot outside. Also lovely to have breakfast and dinner at different sites of the house in the shade :-)

We absolutely loved this apartment! It was so cute and beautiful decorated. It was close to the centre of Bled and nearby grocery stores. It was quiet and peaceful at night. The owner was lovely and communicative. Would love to come back and stay in the future. Highly recommend!
